name: Teto's Concert
source:
This is a very short VN about Teto, Miku and Neru resolving a conflict behind the scenes of their school's concert of the year!

[Edited from [url=https://100daysummer.itch.io/tetos-concert]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部超短篇视觉小说，讲述了重音Teto、初音未来与亚北音留在学校年度音乐会幕后化解一场矛盾风波的故事！

[摘自[url=https://100daysummer.itch.io/tetos-concert]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
